corpus.text: Cleaning staff have not serviced the isolation ward today
The ward computer froze and I cannot open the patient record screen
We need approval to purchase additional gloves before the budget closes
Request for maternity leave paperwork and the dates that apply
Garden refuse has blocked the drainage outside the mortuary

How many sick days do I have left this year
Please update my bank details for salary payments

Tender documents for cleaning services need finance sign off

Staff training on fire safety needs to be scheduled for the new interns
The lift between the ground and fourth floors is stuck again
A strong smell of gas near the boiler room
Recruitment panel for the ward manager post needs a venue and dates
I would like to apply for annual leave from the first to the fifth of December
The car park gate barrier is broken and ambulances are queuing
Our email stopped syncing on the ward tablets since last night
The nurse call system is not registering requests from room twelve
We need to advertise a vacancy for a radiographer
My payslip for October shows the wrong number of overtime hours
ECG cart will not power on after being moved
Disciplinary hearing outcome letter has not been issued yet
A purchase order was raised with the wrong cost centre
Our bedside monitors lose their link to the central station every few minutes
Medical aid rejected the claim for the surgical admission, please review
Please process the reimbursement for my conference travel expenses
We are short of two night nurses on the paediatric rota this weekend
Ultrasound machine software needs to be reinstalled it shows a licence error
Debtors report shows several accounts over ninety days outstanding
Please confirm my employment contract renewal before the end of the month
Linen delivery is two days late and wards are running out of sheets
Security guard needed at the pharmacy entrance after hours
A ceiling panel in the waiting area has water stains and looks ready to fall
Petty cash float is empty and receipts need to be reconciled
The hospital bed in room eight has a broken side rail
Paint is peeling badly in the children's play area
Cash up discrepancy at the outpatient cashier this morning
I was not paid for the extra shifts I covered last month
The fire extinguisher in block C is past its inspection date
I submitted a grievance two weeks ago and have had no feedback
A virus warning keeps appearing on the reception pc
Hot water is not available in the female ward showers
A pipe is leaking under the sink in the staff kitchen
I am locked out of my account and the password reset email never arrives
The cold room temperature alarm is sounding in the main kitchen
Audit query about missing supporting documents for last quarter payments
A new staff member starts Monday and needs an induction session booked
VAT on the equipment lease invoice seems wrong
Request to write off a small unrecoverable patient balance
Forecast of next quarter's consumables spend is needed for planning
Employee wellness day request for the whole theatre team
Credit note has not been applied to the supplier's account
The supplier says our invoice from August is still unpaid and is threatening to stop delivery
Backup of the patient admissions database failed overnight
Need pest control for cockroaches near the canteen
The agency staff who covered our ward last week need their timesheets signed
Can I get a statement for the account of the patient admitted on the ninth
The printer on the third floor will not connect to the shared drive
The automatic door at the emergency entrance is jammed
Who approves study leave for the nursing diploma exams
The infusion pump display shows an error code after the update
My UIF and pension deductions look incorrect on this month's pay
The theatre scheduling application keeps crashing when I save a booking
Our department is over its monthly spending limit, who must approve extra funds
Please confirm that the payment to the medical gas vendor went out on Friday
The ventilator alarm panel is unresponsive and needs engineering to look at it
Barcode scanner at pharmacy dispensing stopped reading wristbands
Can the roster be changed so I do not work consecutive night shifts
The generator did not start during the power cut this afternoon
Radiology viewer is extremely slow and images fail to load
The quotation for the new autoclave exceeds what we budgeted
VPN will not let the on call doctor log in from home
Medical waste bins are overflowing and have not been collected
Telemetry feed for the cardiac unit is lagging behind real time
Wireless signal is dropping in the maternity corridor all morning
The tariff applied to the maternity package looks too high
Dialysis machine touchscreen is not responding to touch
A patient was billed twice for the same procedure and wants a refund

patterns.why: Honorific plus surname names a specific person
Names a staff member; confirm this is not a patient
Bed or cubicle number can single out a patient
Describes an individual by relationship, place or history
Pronoun linked to a medical condition or treatment
Special personal information about an individual (POPIA s26)
